tools.name: find_endpoint
tools.description: Find which SocialTap tool and endpoint serves a need ("TikTok comments", "YouTube transcript") or a link: returns the best matches with the tool and arguments to call, the price, the parameters and an example result. Use it when no tool obviously fits, or to check which platforms and links a tool ta

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: Public posts (videos, reels, shorts, photos, carousels, tweets and text) with their author, text, media, and views, likes and comments. Pass url: its link or ID. Price per successful call: 1 credit.

tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: The posts of a profile, a page per call: public posts (videos, reels, shorts, photos, carousels, tweets and text) with their author, text, media, and views, likes and comments. Pass handle: a profile link, @handle, username or ID. Price per successful page: Bluesky, Facebook, Instagram, Kwai, Reddit

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Public accounts (creators, channels, pages, companies, communities) with their bio, links, and follower and post counts. Pass handle: a profile link, @handle, username or ID. Price per successful call: Apple Music, Bluesky, Facebook, GitHub, Google, Hacker News, Instagram, Komi, Kwai, Lnk.Bio, Linkm

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: The comments of a post, a page per call: public comments and replies with their author, text, place in the thread, and like and reply counts. Pass url: its link or ID. Price per successful page: Bluesky, Facebook, Hacker News, Instagram, Reddit, Rumble, Snapchat, Threads, TikTok, X, YouTube: 1 credi

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: Timed transcripts of public videos: the platform's caption track, or speech-to-text on the audio when there is none. Pass url: its link or ID. Price per successful call: Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Reddit, Rumble, TikTok, X, YouTube: 1 credit (captions) or 2 credits + 2 per started minute of medi

tools.name: get_engagement
tools.description: Engagement rate, average views, likes and comments, posting cadence and top post for an account, computed from its recent posts the same way on every platform. Pass handle: a profile link, @handle, username or ID. Price per successful call: Facebook, Instagram, Reddit, Rumble, TikTok, X, YouTube: 1

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search a platform by query for ads, advertisers, albums, channels, comments, communities, events, groups, hashtags, issues, jobs, places, playlists, podcasts, posts, products, profiles, repositories, sounds, suggestions or top. Pass platform, type and query. Types by platform: amazon: products; appl

tools.name: call_endpoint
tools.description: Call any endpoint by the ID find_endpoint gives (tiktok.sound_posts), with the arguments it gives: the data the other tools here don't cover. Same price, results and cursors as the endpoint's own tool.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the SocialTap docs (guides, the API reference, error codes, schemas, pricing) for a question or term: returns the best-matching sections with their page, a snippet and the path to read with read_doc. Use it before writing integration code. Free, and it works without an API key.

tools.name: read_doc
tools.description: Read one SocialTap docs page as Markdown: a path from search_docs or llms.txt (/docs/pagination/), or a full docs URL. Long pages come in parts: call again with cursor=next_cursor for the rest. Free, and it works without an API key.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Get the account, balance and calling key. The account's balance and plan, the low-balance alert threshold, and the calling key: its scopes, spend limit (with what it used this interval) and expiry. Free; never cached. Use it to check the credit balance before a large task; every other result already

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_endpoint, get_post, list_posts, get_profile, list_comments, get_transcript, get_engagement, search, read_doc · Private data: find_endpoint, search_docs, read_doc · Public sink: get_post, get_profile, list_comments, get_engagement.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_endpoint, get_post, list_posts, get_profile, list_comments, get_transcript, get_engagement, search, read_doc · Private data: find_endpoint, search_docs, read_doc · Public sink: get_post, get_profile, list_comments, get_engagement

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
